name: Advanced Safety Systems
appl: This attachment can be applied to all melee and ranged weapons (including grenades) that require a Matrix connection.
system: The weapon cannot be turned on or fired unless the persona of the current weapon's owner is authorized by the owner of the weapon.
mods: 1x Self-Destruction (if an unauthorized user tries to fire the weapon, it detonates, dealing one Critical Injury, and is then destroyed)

name: Attachable Stock
appl: This attachment can be applied to all guns and crossbows without the Cumbersome quality, except Holdout Pistols and Tasers.
system: As a maneuver, the stock can be attached or detached from the weapon. When attached to a one-handed ranged weapon, the weapon can be fired with the Ranged (Heavy) skill, and increases their Encumbrance rating by 2. When detached from a two-handed ranged weapon, the weapon gains the Inaccurate 2 quality, but decreases its Encumbrance rating by 2. The stock itself has an Encumbrance rating of 2 while detached. Two-handed ranged weapons replace their pre-built stock with this, and do not increase their Encumbrance rating due to this attachment.
mods: 1x Folding Stock (Attach or Detach stock as an Incidental)

name: Suppressor
appl: This attachment can be applied to pistols, submachine guns, assault rifles, precision rifles and sniper rifles.
desc:
As the classic assassin’s accessory, suppressors allow a user to keep unwanted attention from themselves by
  suppressing noise. Unlike the silencers often found in mainstream action trideos, suppressors do not make a gun
  magically imperceptible; If a suppressed weapon is fired inside a small enclosed room, people will notice the gunfire.
  Rather, a suppressor will distort the sound of gunfire to a point that people will not perceive it as such, especially
  when the sound comes from behind a bunch of walls. This additionally hinders witnesses of an assassination in locating
  the shooter in time.

Due to this, after-market attachments of suppressors are generally illegal, but more often than not, corporate
  security – especially those within arcologies – carry suppressed weapons to deal with criminals without enticing mass
  panic within the closed environment. Guns sold with integrated suppressors are therefore known and registered, and –
  with the right licenses of course – legal to buy and carry.

Suppressors come in two variants: Attached and integrated. Attached suppressors do not cost Hard Points, but are
  rather big and clunky, and therefor add one point of Encumbrance to the weapon while attached. Attaching a suppressor
  uses a maneuver, and getting caught with one is generally a bad idea. Integrated suppressors are built into the gun
  barrel itself. They cost a single Hard Point, but do not add to the weapons bulk. Spotting an inbuilt suppressor
  requires a Hard ([[ddd]]) Perception or Mechanics check.
system:
Adds [[ss]] to all Perception or Vigilance checks made to
  locate a concealed shooter. Inbuild suppressors require a Hard ([[ddd]]) Perception
  or Mechanics check to be spotted.
mods: 2x Improvement (add additional [[s]] to Perception and Vigilance skill checks to spot shooter)
